title: Copilot Studio: app- and intent-first agent creation experience
summary: The roadmap facts, existing governance controls and billing qualifications are supported. One descriptive sentence assumes a unified tools-and-knowledge screen, whereas Microsoft describes only a unified experience and has not documented the new screens.

claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience

claims.claim: Makers will start with the application their agent will work with.
claims.quote: Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Agents, workflows and apps powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness use usage-based billing measured in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Agents, workflows, and apps powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness ... use a usage-based billing structure. ... Usage is billed based on consumption and measured in Copilot Credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot harness charges Copilot Credits from the moment a maker starts building.
claims.quote: Unlike the standard harness, which starts billing after publish, the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment you start building.

claims.claim: Previewing and evaluating Microsoft Copilot harness agents consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Experiences such as creating an automated solution with natural language, previewing and testing an agent, and generating and creating agent evaluations all consume credits.

claims.claim: The billing overview distinguishes the standard harness as starting billing after publication.
claims.quote: Unlike the standard harness, which starts billing after publish, the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment you start building.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The charges for building specifically through the new creation flow are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "app-first" licensing Copilot Credits meter default enable rollout roles prerequisites existing agents. Opened: Overview of usage-based billing; Manage costs for agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Neither identifies this flow's harness or building charges.

claims.claim: Administrators can allocate prepaid Copilot Credits to environments.
claims.quote: As a Power Platform administrator, you can use controls in the Power Platform admin center to allocate prepaid credits, limit consumption, monitor usage, and identify agents created through the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: Turning off Draw from the available capacity in my tenant caps prepaid consumption at the environment allocation.
claims.quote: To contain prepaid consumption, allocate a defined amount of Copilot Credits to the environment and turn off Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.

claims.claim: A linked pay-as-you-go billing plan can continue funding usage after the prepaid allocation is consumed.
claims.quote: When you clear this option, the environment doesn't draw from unallocated prepaid capacity in the tenant after it consumes its allocation. If the environment is linked to a pay-as-you-go billing plan, usage can continue through the linked Azure subscription.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: data policy row
claims.claim: The data policy page is reached in Power Platform admin center through Security > Data and privacy > Data policy.
claims.quote: On the sidebar, select Security, and then select Data and privacy. The Data protection and privacy page opens. ... Select Data policy. The Data policies list appears.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: data policy row
claims.claim: Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell provides New-DlpPolicy -DisplayName <name> -EnvironmentType <type> to create a data policy.
claims.quote: Module: Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell Module. ... New-DlpPolicy -DisplayName <String> -EnvironmentType <String> ... The New-DlpPolicy cmdlet creates a new DLP policy for the logged in admin's tenant.

claims.claim: Copilot Credit management is reached through Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Power Platform admin center. ... In the navigation pane, select Licensing. ... Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 is the documented allocation-write operation, including tenant-capacity draw enforcement.
claims.quote: The allocationsV2 operation writes an environment's allocation. All programmatic examples in this article use API version 2024-10-01. ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put ... -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"

claims.claim: Environment capacity controls apply across Copilot Studio credit-consuming workloads rather than only to the Microsoft Copilot harness.
claims.quote: Environment capacity controls apply to all Copilot Studio workloads in the environment, not only agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: The data policy page lists tenant administrator as a qualifying role.
claims.quote: Be a tenant admin or have the Environment Admin role.

claims.claim: The credit allocation tutorial lists Power Platform Administrator as a qualifying role.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: The credit allocation tutorial lists Global Administrator as a qualifying role.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: An equivalent role able to manage licensing and capacity also satisfies the credit tutorial's role prerequisite.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: The Cost controls - Draw from tenant credit pool environment group rule governs access to unallocated tenant Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Use the Cost controls - Draw from tenant credit pool environment groups rule to control whether environments in a group can use unallocated Copilot Credits from the tenant pool.

claims.claim: Publishing that group rule makes the governed environment-level setting read-only in Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: When you publish a rule, it governs every environment in the group. The environment-level setting becomes read-only in the Power Platform admin center

claims.claim: Programmatic requests cannot override the environment setting governed by the published group rule.
claims.quote: The environment-level setting becomes read-only in the Power Platform admin center, and programmatic requests can't override it.
